verdict.rationale: The evidence documents ingestion through thread.add_messages and the supported data types (JSON, text, message). zepctl mentions generic 'data operations'. Nothing documents async or batch ingestion at scale, or any way to check the status of background memory operations. The axis applies to a memory service, so the missing evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can ingest at scale with async or batch processing and check the status of background memory operations
